title: Glob: AbortSignal cancellation bypass allows post-timeout filesystem traversal
reason: Inside npm 11.21.2, which @semantic-release/npm installs to run the release: npm depends on glob 13.0.6 and minimatch 10.2.5, and the patched releases are majors it does not accept (glob 14, minimatch 11). Dev-only, not in the published site. Pinning a package manager's own dependency graph to satisfy an advisory is a worse trade than the advisory; the fix belongs in npm.
